selection_evidence.source: parent confirmed completed query matched-pair analyzer result
selection_evidence.interpretation: First-update gradient availability does not prove useful learned dependence. Selection of this diagnostic follows failed gate; validation does not enter its sampling, loss-gradient readout or ablation metrics.

questions: At fixed final shared-model states, do the joint-objective parameter gradients for predetermined training geometries conflict?
Does the trained actual query32 vary spatially and affect the learned predictions usefully on those SAME training queries, rather than only having passed first-update backprop checks?
checkpoint_rule: Only each branch last.pt at step10000. Verify status/step/config/saved model contract; do not use different best-val checkpoints, choose checkpoint by diagnostic result, load/restart optimizer or update any parameter. Set eval to disable training-only guards while preserving differentiable model forwards for loss gradients.

data_contract.selection: fixed diagnosed TRAIN101_479 plus lexicographically first3 remaining TRAIN CADs; independent of case errors
data_contract.geometry: existing canonicalver normalizedxyz/rolesactual/1024cloud/mask/nodeindices, local13 and existing correct mesh gradient cache; no new resampling, CSV/H5 download or geometry reconstruction
data_contract.GT_allowed_later: only signeduXYZ and derived existing TRAIN P1 references for these12 cases, required to compute this supervised diagnostic; no stress/val/dia/test target field
data_contract.normalizers: reuse original40TRAIN commonu RMS=.05511113670847156mm, per-case relative-u weights and existing full-volume traincase P1 loss reference/floors. Do not refit/recalibrate any scaler or denominator.
data_contract.physics: same load-linear9-basis/config102/newquery32/global32/query38/nativewidth128/PointNet5 and fixed sigma=.15; no architecture/loss/kernel changes

sampling_predeclaration.RNG: CPU NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([...])) so source witnesses are portable and independent of device RNG/history
sampling_predeclaration.node_rows: concat6400 uniform node indices and existing cache corner_node_indices[selected1600tets].reshape(-1) ->12800 unchanged FEM indices
sampling_predeclaration.duplicates: retain exactly, including repeat tets/corners; do not unique/sort/resample
sampling_predeclaration.selected_cells: same1600cell IDs for P1 training-loss diagnostic in everyknownload/model for this CAD
sampling_predeclaration.total_rows_per_model: 4CAD*3loads*12800=153600 case-rows; unique geometry query vectors may be reused across3load conditions without changing rows or backward accounting
sampling_predeclaration.witness_output: record node_count/cell_count, RNG entropy, selectednode/tet/corner/concatenatedrowindices or small witness NPZ, and canonical C-contiguous integer-byte hashes; same hashes acrossall controls. No gigantic full data hashes.

gradient_readout.loss_per_case: L_case = unchangedrelativeLu_case + fixedlambda * unchangedvolumeweighted normalizedcornerP1 symmetricFrobenius L_eps_case, using the same sampled12800rows/1600tets
gradient_readout.CAD_loss: mean of ver/hor/tor L_case; no case-gradient normalization before averaging
gradient_readout.gradient: g_CAD = (grad L_ver + grad L_hor + grad L_tor)/3 at fixed checkpoint
gradient_readout.cap_accounting: 2trained models*4CAD*3loads=24 casebackwards max. Clear parametergrad buffers between cases and accumulate detached numeric gradients perCAD; alternatively one differentiable mean-of3load backward perCAD is mathematically equivalent and belowcap. No secondderivatives or optimizer steps.
parameter_blocks: native decoder params (hash+MLP together; no unsupported flat-buffer offset guessing)
PointNet encoder params (point MLP and global head)
gradient_readout.block_rules: disjoint parameter ownership, stable named flattening and order recorded; include full concatenated-model gradient as main summary. Verify finite gradients. Do not mix duplicated params or compare vectors across DIFFERENT checkpoint parameter states.
gradient_readout.pair_cosine: cos(g_A,g_B)=dot/(normA*normB) for the6unordered CAD pairs within EACH trained model, fullmodel and3blocks
gradient_readout.zero_norm: if normA ornormB=0, cosine null plus explicit zero_norm flag, never silently0; trainedqueryzero projection gradients expectedzero
gradient_readout.joint_direction_readout: g_mean=(g_1+g_2+g_3+g_4)/4; record dot(g_CAD,g_mean) and dot(g_CAD,mean(other3)) signs/norms. Negative dot with g_mean predicts local increase of that CAD objective under infinitesimal plain gradient descent; negative paircos alone does not guarantee g_mean harms it.
gradient_readout.components: record Lu andrawnormalizedL_eps scalar percase/CAD andlambda for interpretability; the vector cosine is of the prescribed JOINT objective, not separate losses or a reweighted norm blend.
gradient_readout.Adam_limit: These are parameter-gradient alignments, not actual native Adam update directions. Momentum/preconditioning and finite precision can change effects; no claim that an optimizer step necessarily harms/improves a case.

actual_query_intervention_and_variation.intervention: Only trainedactual last10k: keep exactly its learned parameters, canonicalrolesactual, global32, query38, inputs/alphas andsigma; compute currentquery32 then multiply finalquery32slots by0 for alternative forward. Do not substitute the separately trainedzero checkpoint orzero BC roles.
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.forwards_only: intactactual andsame-weights-query-masked forwards in no_grad; no additionalbackwards beyond24, no model/state/optimizer updates. Restore/verify intact mode after intervention.
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.output_sensitivity: percase physical u difference norm ||u_intact-u_masked|| / ||u_true|| on SAME12800training rows, with finite/nonzero denominator check; disclose query-sampled/duplicate row weighting, not allnode validation score
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.local_usefulness: samebatch Lu,rawL_eps andjointloss for intactvsmasked; report sign of delta(masked-intact). Large predictionchange by itself is not useful-information evidence.
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.context_variation: for eachCAD compute q32meanvector andquery-centeredRMS=sqrt(mean((q-mean_queryq)^2)); magnitudeRMS=sqrt(mean(q^2)); retain channelstdvector if cheap. Also4CAD pairwise RMS distances of q32meanvectors andglobal32vectors. These are learned input-context readouts, no GTderived feature.
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.known_control: trainedzero finalquery32 is identically0; report as a structuralcontrol, not an empirical lack of geometryinformation.
actual_query_intervention_and_variation.limits: Actual latent query0 can be offdistribution to its trained decoder, so masking sensitivity is a local input intervention, not mutualinformation or proof of source-feature sufficiency; sampled contextvariation cannot prove complete loadpath representation.

predeclared_interpretation_branches.negative_CAD_gradient_alignment_with_act: supports local shared-gradient interference as a plausible contribution at the tested fixed states; conditioned information can be locally useful while joint training still compromises cases. Doesnot prove optimization is the only issue.
predeclared_interpretation_branches.actual_query_varies_but_masking_not_bene: the branch is spatially active but not demonstrably helpful on these sampledTRAIN losses; gradient availability was insufficient evidence of useful learnedcontext. Doesnot imply sourceinput lacks all needed information.
predeclared_interpretation_branches.actual_query_small_variation_and_small_s: little spatially varying/used querysignal on this probe or redundancy with global/local features; distinguishes this learned path from its potential capability, without automatic sigma/attention retuning.
predeclared_interpretation_branches.mostly_aligned_gradients_with_locally_he: doesnot show strong conflict for these4CAD/probes at thesefinal states; representation adequacy, otherCADs, traininghistory and finiteoptimization remain unresolved. Do not conclude shared optimization is solved or missing information is proven.
predeclared_interpretation_branches.state_or_component_dependent_conflict: report which native/encoder/projection block andCADpair shows it, with norms; a tiny-norm block cosine is not the main full-modelmechanism. Differences between trainedzero/actual histories remain observational.
predeclared_interpretation_branches.scope: all branches are TRAIN diagnostics, not finaltest, unseenload, unseenCAD validation improvement, statistical significance or newalgorithm. No follow-up experiment is selected from these signs by this plan.

predeclared_stop.stop_after: exact4CAD*3load*2fixedcheckpoints andactualquerymask/contextvariation readout; one JSONresult thenreturnto parent
predeclared_stop.abort_on: wrong checkpointstep/contract, wrongCAD group/geometryalignment, witness mismatch, nonfinite gradients/loss/context or unsupported parameterblockmapping; recorderror, no silent fallbacks
predeclared_stop.forbidden: no radius/kernel/loss/width/capacity/coefficient/seed sweep, no specialist continuation, no weighttraining, no val/dia/finaltest target read, no mainplan/frozen-source/README edit
